purpose: Connect a result to its cause, method, agent, or varying condition.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Noun + によって; noun + による + noun
The bridge was damaged by the typhoon.
The fee varies depending on the payment method.
This is a work by a young architect.
formation: Noun + によって; noun + による + noun
restrictions: The intended relationship depends on the noun and predicate.
mistake: For everyday tools like a pen, で is usually more natural than によって.
